correctness.rationale: For squarefree cyclic group each proper nontrivial subgroup corresponds to a proper nonempty missing-prime support and product=whole group iff missing supports are disjoint. Removing r size-(r-1) pendant supports leaves V=2^r-r-2 possible cycle vertices. For any 2-regular subgraph, twice degrees give a-b=e_A-e_B and |V(F)|<=2|B|+e_A. At even rank 2k only complementary k-set pairs yield internal A edges, at most C(2k,k)/2. At odd 2k+1 internal A edges are (k,k) or (k,k+1); incidence at k level bounds x+2y<=2c and x<=c, hence e_A<=floor(3c/2). Both yield U=2^r-2-ceil(c/2). Verified entire stated r=5,6,7 explicit disjoint cycles and symbolic level structure for ranks5..12 with independently written exact bitset certificate. These finite witnesses prove only 2-regular sharpness at those ranks; all-r bound follows from the general counting proof, not enumeration.
residual_risks: Does not prove exact circumference r>=8 or equality of max single cycle and max cycle COVER.
Does not address repeated prime factors or noncyclic groups.
